title: FC 3309: Fire Alarm Reporting
officialText:
3309.1 Emergency telephone.

A telephone not requiring a coin to operate, or another approved, clearly identified means to notify the department, shall be provided on site in an approved location. The street address of the construction site and the emergency telephone number of the fire department shall be posted adjacent to the telephone or other approved device.
